verses.text: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.

segments.text: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.

verses.text: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.

segments.text: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.

segments.text: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

verses.text: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.

segments.text: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.

verses.text: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,

segments.text: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,

verses.text: O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.

segments.text: O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.

verses.text: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.

segments.text: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.

verses.text: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—

segments.text: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—

verses.text: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.

segments.text: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.

verses.text: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

segments.text: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:

verses.text: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”

segments.text: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”

verses.text: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,

segments.text: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,

verses.text: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

segments.text: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.

verses.text: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:

segments.text: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:

verses.text: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”

segments.text: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”

verses.text: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.

segments.text: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.

verses.text: He sent a man before them—Joseph, sold as a slave.

segments.text: He sent a man before them—Joseph, sold as a slave.

segments.text: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,

segments.text: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.

verses.text: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.

segments.text: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.

verses.text: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,

segments.text: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.

segments.text: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,

segments.text: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.

verses.text: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

segments.text: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

verses.text: He sent darkness, and it became dark—yet they defied His words.

segments.text: He sent darkness, and it became dark—yet they defied His words.

segments.text: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.

segments.text: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.

segments.text: He spoke, and insects swarmed—gnats throughout their country.

verses.text: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.

verses.text: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.
